title.value: NetInfoF Framework: Measuring and Exploiting Network Usable Information

TLDR.value: We propose a framework that measures the usable information of graphs and exploits it to solve the graph tasks, namely link prediction and node classification.

primary_area.value: learning on graphs and other geometries & topologies
